The marketing agent that knows your business and does the work

Studio FAQs

What is Studio?

Studio is your always-on AI marketing agent that knows your business. Grounded in your Acme data and business context, Studio helps you uncover opportunities, understand what’s driving performance, and turn insights into action. From deeper analysis to creating and improving campaigns, flows, audiences, and more, Studio helps you get more done, all within Acme.

What can Studio help me do?

Studio helps you analyze, create, and act across your marketing. Use it to:

  • Analyze performance and uncover opportunities across your account
  • Run deeper audits of campaigns, flows, forms, and audiences
  • Get answers and recommendations grounded in your Acme data
  • Build and refine segments and audiences
  • Create campaigns, flows, and messages
  • Turn insights and recommendations into action directly in Acme
  • Schedule recurring tasks so Studio can take on repeatable work

How does Studio use my business data?

Studio brings together the context it needs to understand your business. That includes data already in Acme, like customer behavior, engagement, campaigns, flows, and performance—as well as relevant context from connected external tools and data sources. With MCP-powered connections, Studio can incorporate information from across your marketing stack to deliver analysis, recommendations, and actions grounded in your business, not generic AI responses.

Can Studio analyze my marketing performance?

Yes. Studio can analyze your Acme data to answer questions, investigate performance, audit your marketing, and identify opportunities for improvement. You can ask follow-up questions and dig deeper without having to manually pull together reports or navigate between different parts of Acme.

What can Studio create?

Studio can help create marketing experiences directly within Acme, including campaigns, flows, messages, segments, and more. Because Studio understands your Acme account and business context, it can move from understanding an opportunity to helping you build what you need to act on it.

Can Studio complete tasks for me?

Yes. Studio goes beyond providing answers and recommendations by helping you take action directly in Acme. Depending on the task, you can use Studio to create new marketing experiences, make changes to existing work, or schedule recurring tasks, while keeping control over what ultimately reaches your customers.

Can I schedule recurring tasks with Studio?

Yes. You can schedule tasks for Studio to run on a recurring basis, making it easier to stay on top of work that would otherwise require repeated manual analysis. For example, you can have Studio regularly check for opportunities or issues and surface what needs your attention.

Does Studio make changes or publish anything without my approval?

You stay in control of customer-facing marketing. Studio can help analyze, create, and make changes within Acme, while giving you the opportunity to review customer-facing work before it goes live.

How is Studio different from ChatGPT or other AI tools?

General-purpose AI tools can help with individual tasks, but Studio is an AI marketing agent purpose-built for your marketing and already knows your business. It brings together your Acme data and business context with purpose-built marketing capabilities to analyze performance, uncover opportunities, and take action on your behalf. And with connections to external tools and data sources, Studio can work with context across your marketing stack, not just what you provide in a prompt.

What channels does Studio support?

Studio can help create and optimize marketing across Acme’s supported channels, including email, SMS, mobile push, WhatsApp, and RCS. Channel availability may vary by account and feature.

Do I need a Acme account to use Studio?

Yes. Studio is built directly into Acme and uses your Acme data and business context to provide more relevant analysis, recommendations, and marketing experiences.

How do I get access to Studio?

Studio is available within Acme, with free and paid access options depending on your account and usage. Visit Acme’s pricing page for the latest information on Studio plans and availability.
